cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts ten or more institutions or systems connected; no source names the bodies whose data passes through the platform.
cells.note: On 1 June 2026 the communications authority's chairman said the National Data Distributor links government agencies, banks and service sectors and carried over 300 million transactions in 2025, so it is in service between public bodies. No count of ten connected is held, so it is not stage 4.
